english.title: Raves - prepare to / attend a further gathering within 24 hours of S. 62 direction

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that a direction given under section 63(2) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 applied to you,

(A)_[made preparations for]_
(B)_[attended]_

a gathering to which section 63 of the Act applies within twenty four hours of that direction having being given
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(7A) and(7B) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
